item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-04
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. The `scienceverse/metacheck` and `giladfeldman/escicheck` projects have both received updates, with `metacheck` introducing dedicated import and export of files and `escicheck` synchronizing with the `escicheckapp` repository to reflect the latest `effectcheck` version. Meanwhile, `giladfeldman/docpluck` has made notable strides, including a new release and the recovery of lost work due to Dropbox sync damage. Additionally, `Davidvandijcke/coarse` and `JamieCummins/regcheck` have both seen multiple commits addressing various issues and preparing for upcoming releases, highlighting the connections between these projects as they work towards improving their respective tools. Overall, it's exciting to see our community's projects advancing and collaborating to drive progress in open-source research.

35 commits across 6 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.1

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, docpluck, escicheck

item.title: docpluck: 5 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

The `main` branch was the focus of the recent work, where a handoff process was initiated with "run-4 fresh-session handoff" to clear the "run-3 punch-list" and continue iterating. Additionally on the `main` branch, the "run-3 guard-diff + FP-scan scripts" were preserved under the `tools/diag/` directory as part of a diagnostic chore. The `main` branch also saw the closure of "run-3" with the shipping of "W0l+W0m" versions "v2.4.116/117", and the updating of the punch-list to reflect the current state. A release was made on the `main` branch for "W0m β-as-'b' layout-gated recovery" with version "v2.4.117" packaging for the glyph component. The `main` branch also underwent a restoration process to recover 107 uncommitted lines that were lost due to Dropbox sync damage on July 20, 2026.

5 commit(s) today:

  • 9daf808 [main] docs(handoff): run-4 fresh-session handoff — clear the run-3 punch-list and continue iterating — Gilad Feldman
  • c5d75aa [main] chore(diag): preserve run-3 guard-diff + FP-scan scripts under tools/diag/ — Gilad Feldman
  • fcf3eaf [main] docs(triage+handoff): run-3 close — W0l+W0m shipped (v2.4.116/117); punch-list current — Gilad Feldman
  • 63fb143 [main] release(glyph): W0m β-as-'b' layout-gated recovery — v2.4.117 packaging — Gilad Feldman
  • 3b24a20 [main] restore: recover 107 uncommitted lines lost to 2026-07-20 Dropbox sync damage — Gilad Feldman

item.title: escicheck: activity update
item.description:
giladfeldman/escicheck

The `main` branch was updated with a commit that synchronizes it with the `escicheckapp` repository at version `7c4eb22`, which corresponds to `effectcheck` version `0.6.14`, as indicated by the commit message "sync from escicheckapp@7c4eb22 (effectcheck v0.6.14)". This commit is associated with issue `#27`. No other branches were worked on in this set of commits. The specific change made was to bring the `main` branch in line with the `escicheckapp` repository at the specified version. The `effectcheck` version `0.6.14` is now reflected in the `main` branch.
